DayInfo.title: DayInfo
DayInfo.description: Short per-day entry for the day navigation panel: a day with at least one shift.

DaySummary.title: DaySummary
DaySummary.description: Totals of all trips in the shifts that started on this local day.

DriverInfo.title: DriverInfo
DriverInfo.description: A driver as the admin sees them: profile plus totals.

DriverUpdate.title: DriverUpdate
DriverUpdate.description: PATCH /api/admin/drivers/{id}: only the fields that were sent are changed.

Profile.title: Profile
Profile.description:
The logged-in account. Driver fields are None for admins: an admin is a
user without a driver profile.

ShiftPatch.title: ShiftPatch
ShiftPatch.description: Changes to a shift; omitted fields keep their values. `end: null` reopens it.

ShiftStartIn.title: ShiftStartIn
ShiftStartIn.description: Start a shift now (no fields), at a given time, or enter a past shift (start + end).

TripIn.title: TripIn
TripIn.description: Trip as sent by a client. The id is optional.

TripPatch.title: TripPatch
TripPatch.description: Changes to a stored trip; omitted fields keep their values. The id never changes.
